title: iteration-status
description: Output of an implementer run in build mode, and the exit contract of one driver iteration. The orchestrator reads `status`; everything else is a record.

status.description: progressed: continue; waiting: nothing runnable, a human must answer a deviation; gate: a human must review; done: terminate() true; error: toolchain or harness failure, retry with a cap

claimed.description: slugs the implementer believes covered; informational only — the verifier does not read it

stoppedEarly.description: true when the run stopped before finishing its portion (run limit): the portion stays in-progress and the next iteration runs the implementer on it again

gate.description: reason written to the gate file, when status is gate
